commits.summary: Note that pgrep -f on a command's text never ends a wait
commits.body: The L01-L20 and M01-M10 setup agents both waited for sync.py commit with an until ! pgrep -f loop. The loop's own command line matches the pattern, so it spun long after the commit landed (the M setup had four such loops, up to 40 minutes old). The note gives the waits that do end: foreground, wait PID, kill -0, or a bracketed pattern.
